nom: SUNDAY RILEY Auto Correct Brightening and Depuffing Eye Cream

avis.titre: I had to give it a chance to work
avis.texte: I wasn't sure this was working maybe because I had to give it a few more minutes. I feel like I don't have to wear makeup lately! It's hot outside and make up rolls off . This makes me feel fresh and revived. No puffy craters. It has helped my husband too. It's now part of our morning ritual

Waited until I used up the whole bottle before I wrote the review. I love Sunday Riley but honestly, I didn't really see much difference with my eyes. It's a nice cream and it goes well underneath your makeup, but my eyes didn't seem less puffy or any brighter. I'm going to try something else.

Hit my 30's and started searching for solutions to help with the light facial puffiness I see in the AM. I use this as part of my morning skin care routine, just before I apply my makeup. A tiny bead is all you need and I pat it under my eyes, between my brows & on the brow bone. Its even nice for the allergy season where my nose and nasolabial folds have a touch of puff to them! It works well with my non-silicone makeup products, doesnt leave my skin greasy, and is gentle enough for daily use without irritation. My skin type: dry but can get oily (causing breakouts) quick with the wrong products.
I would like to see a picture of the people who say this doesn't work? I mean if you're starting out looking like the crypt keeper come on this is just a lotion not surgery 🫢😂

avis.titre: Corner of eyes burn + eye irritation
avis.texte: I wanted to give this a try after using kiehls for years. However, after using for a month I am giving up on it because I am experiencing burning around my eyes and my eyes are irritated. Disappointed :/ back to kiehls.

I've tried fiftyleven eye creams and I'm here to tell you this is the one. I have one fine line under my eyes with puffiness, hollowness, and some darkness, the results are quick & noticeable with this one. I'm so glad I decided to buy it! Got it on sale too, makes it so much sweeter.

avis.titre: Maybe Not For Everyone, But For ME!
avis.texte: I was gifted this product by my friend. We traveled together and one day i had gotten really bad sleep and developed dark under eye circles and lines. He recommended his eye cream to me (this product) and i used it expecting to honestly not see much of a result. 2 hours later, we were in an elevator with a mirror and i looked at myself (vanity, i know..) and there was nothing under my eyes but smooth skin!! Dark circles and lines were gone. It may not be for everyone according to some reviews, but it did me SO well. Grateful for finding this product.

I used this eye cream for 2 days and had to stop becasue my face is swollen with an itchy rash!! I have sensitive skin but good lord this is awful. Ive nevwr had anything like this. Can't seem to get the swelling down and the rash to go away. Please test on hand before using. Will be returning.

Dehydration, cold climate, aging, dehydration and holiday in retail made my undereyes look creased when I smiled: always a "moon-smile" with laugh-lines which run in my family... til now. A sample packette came with some newness I bought online with Ulta. Normally I dont bother with eye creams- Florida humidity makes everything melt anyway... but I suddenly needed help! SOS!! Although I read all the reviews of products (from you-all) before I buy, I liked the Sunday Riley Id tried in the past. Mainly the fancy price pervaded my repurchasing for life... but after trying the packette I was hooked. Only a quarter of a pea size under each eye tapped in (and only under the eye). I woke thinking it looked a little better... well- I used the whole packette! it took 4-5 days am and pm. The result? Im not hearing "Ma'am" when I talk to clients anymore. How wonderful!! Im all for politeness but Ma'am is crushing. No smell no stinging no- nothing wierd: just smoothed undereyes. I think the trick is using less, and if one needs it...not using it for younger eyes which Do Not Need this type of eye product just because its gifted. Be happy if you dont!!! Enjoy your lovely young smooth eyes... leave this one for us gals who really benefit from this type of product. 10/10!

avis.titre: I have been buying this product for months.
avis.texte: I love this product! It actually takes away my eye puffiness and softens the lines! I look & feel younger!

avis.titre: Great for brightening around the eyes
avis.texte: I've been using Auto Correct Eye Cream in the AM for years and have not found anything that compares for brightening under the eyes. I do use a heavier retinol / peptide cream in the PM. And for the last couple of months I switched from Auto Correct to the heavier cream. But it just didn't provide the brightening effect that I had with Auto Correct so I just purchased another Auto Correct.
This is a nice product, easy to work into the skin and actually seems to do what it is supposed to. It would probably work better on younger skin.
This product came highly recommended but it didn't work for me at all. It did absolutely nothing and was a waste of money. I would give it a 0 star rating if possible.

avis.titre: Redness and burning - full of sensitive skin triggers
avis.texte: All of the reviews of this product burning and cause irritation are not a surprise as it is full of irritants !! It uses linalool and limonene as fragrance and BOTH are known to allergies, skin irritation, and are big no nos for anyone with rosacea, excema, sensitive skin, lavendar sensitivity. Benzyl Alcohol under my eyes ? No thank you ! Same with glycolic acid - its a gentle AHA but after your skin is irritated from the other ingredients cone day 5 using this when you thought you were in the clear and the burn starts ? Yeah this is why ! And also for those that can handle the harsh ingredients - Theobrama cacao butter will give you milia (it is 4/5 on comedogenic scale).

I received a sample of this product with an online Ulta purchase and tossed it in my makeup bag to take on vacation because I thought it was a concealer - and I STILL didn't realize it WASN'T a concealer until I just came here to buy a full-sized one. This is impressive, impressive stuff.
Smells horrible! Is it supposed to? It smells rancid so idk if Igot a bad batch or what . Is this a common complaint?

avis.titre: For the cost I should have seen results
avis.texte: I purchased this Auto Correct a couple of months ago. I used it religiously AM and PM as directed. A little goes a long way, so it lasted quite a while. After months of use, I should have seen a change in my under-eye circles. I saw no change whatsoever. I spent the money and saw absolutely no results. I am disappointed, to say the least. For the cost, this should have done at least something. This is the first Sunday Riley product I have ever bought, and it will be my last. I will continue to search for a product that actually delivers on its claims, but at this point, that may be a unicorn. I have tried so many, and they have all ultimately failed epically. Each time I have used up the entire product, without the results they claim that they will have. My quest will continue.

A bottle lasts a long time but I come back to this over and it's sort of a two-in-one for me because it makes my under eyes look lighter immediately but it also lifts & tightens over time. Highly recommended.
An Ulta employee recommended this. Was told id instantly see results. Been using now for several months and am not impressed

This works for quickly to remove wrinkles around the eyes and puffiness around the eyes. Only need to use a tiny amount under the eyes to see results. After washing, I apply a little of the CEO hydration cream. Let that absorb and then apply the Auto Correct.

Did absolutely nothing for my under eye bags or my fine lines. Would get in my eyes causing them to water and itch. I can't see how you can avoid getting this in your eyes when applying so close to them. Irritated skin. Not for me.
I've only had this product a few days so can't say I've seen a lot of results but from the first couple of uses I'm seeing some corrections
I was recommended this product by the Ulta employee. I have been using it for several days and there is no improvement in my dark circles.

I love Sunday Riley products, so I was excited to try the Auto Correct Cream. Unfortunately, like some other reviewers, it dried out all around my eyes. My eyes began watering whenever I used it and after a few more tries, the skin around my eyes were super dry and burned. I wanted to love this, but it's a hard pass.
I really like this eye cream. It does not burn my eyes like some others have.

Great eye serum that isnt sticky or greasy. It does what it says it does. No eye cream will turn you 21 again, but if you look at the ingredients and more importantly the order they are listed in on the back, you should have enough of a reason to try it. Its the most potent "clean" skincare i have found. (A zillion times more effective and than Pacifica.) It can get expensive yes but you can put together a decent AM and PM routine using only about 4 or 5 of their items. I use Auto Correct, C.E.O., Good Genes, Pink Drink, and Retinol A+, and it has been a revelation. My skin actually glows. I am in my forties with some skin laxity and eye bags, and i can tell the difference almost immediately between what is working and what is not. I will be using this eye cream now as long as they keep making it.
Caused my under eye area to get very red, itchy and puffy. While I like the Sunday Riley Ceramide Moisturizer a lot, this product does not work for me.
I am in my mid-thirties. I'm experiencing puffiness and fine lines around the eyes. This cream is AMAZING. I noticed improvements after the first use. 10/10
I struggled with dark circles and puffy undereyes for the last few years and this product has really changed that. I use it daily and noticed a big improvement. I highly recommend it!
I started experimenting with under eye cream the past year before going the drastic and getting filler or laser treatments and I definitely noticed a difference with this product!

The product formulation, texture, fragrance and performance are 100%. I seriously see less visible lines under my eyes when I use this product. I even have tried a little on my fine line lip area, again 100%. When the product was allegedly empty, meaning no more pump disbursement, I decided to disassemble the product packaging. Wow, what an eye opener.. First there is a VERY small plastic pouch INSIDE that a mouth heavy packaging, WOW, as in are you kidding me? There was in fact more product in the small plastic pouch that could not make it through the pumper. I was able to cut a small opening inside the plastic pouch to gain access to the remaining product. PLEASE SR if you are reading this. The product is GREAT, give us more product and LESS waste. We get your upscale brand marketing, just give us more product for the same price.

Last year I bought this for the first time and loved it. The results, the smell, really loved the product. However. The second bottle I purchased smelled like dirty dish towels or that moldy towel smell. I contacted the company and they kindly sent me a replacement bottle. But the replacement bottle also smelled terrible. I asked if perhaps they changed the ingredients but no they simply said smell may vary. Its too expensive to risk purchasing again.

I was introduced to this product via a free gift from a purchase, and fell in love! I work overnights, and looked like a raccoon with bags under my eyes.. I have seen results in a about a week, the bags under my eyes are less.. baggy. And have seen results with the dark circles around my eyes. Love it! This product does burn a bit, but no pain no gain. The benefits definitely outweigh the burning sensation. I do think it is quite expensive, but it is worth it and has lasted me a while.

avis.titre: Highly recommend. I will definitely buy this again & again.
avis.texte: If you go to the store try it without makeup on. Then u can feel it start to tighten your eyes especiallyunderneath. I really do like this product & so buy over again!
This under eye product camouflages the under eye area making it look smoother and brighter. I sometimes put it around my lips to makes the creases look less pronounced

I have always struggled with finding a good eye cream for my dark circles. This one definitely improved my dark circles immediately after application, but the results only last an hour. Not worth the money if you want to see permanent results

I cannot say enough about the Auto Correct eye serum! It is hands down the best eye treatment I have ever used! It truly depuffs and lightens the dark circles around my eyes. I love the way it melts into my skin and leaves my eyes looking completely refreshed! Must have!

I absolutely love Sunday Riley. After great experience with the whole line I use this brand only for skincare. I received a sample of Auto-Correct with a collection set I purchased. One use and it literally burned my eyelids. The pain, itching, peeling, burning and general pain was a shock to me. Obviously I would never use this again. Seems like other reviewers say its the glycolic acid causing this issue, which I have used before in other products without a reaction. Either way, if you are sensitive to that or have sensitive skin in general, I woild highly recommend you be careful with this one. One week on and my eyes are still peeling, red and iritated.
Im fairly new to Sunday Riley. I'm very impressed with each and every product I've used. Each formula delivers visible immediate results which is what we're all seeking.

I have used the entire bottle. I'd say overall it definitely brightens your under eye and makes you look more awake. It won't change the fine lines but I've come to realize no under eye cream can really do that. It is best for brightening. Doesn't burn at all (I read a few reviews that said that). I use a different eye serum for tightening and fine lines but I think I'm going back to this one once the tube is done with my current eye serum.

I purchased this product a little over a week ago and ever since I've been pretty good about applying both AM and PM. I realize no product is an immediate miracle worker, but I think this eye cream may fool some people because it has "brightening" properties (basically a shimmery, lightening TINT). I appreciate the brightness it brings, but I fear I didn't purchase appropriately for the issues I was truly trying to combat. I've read some folks have experienced a burning sensation. My first application I had that experience, but I think my skin may be sensitive to caffeine (this happened when I used an Ordinary eye serum with caffeine and/or I over retinol'd so my skin was extra sensitive that day). After that first time, I never had that burning sensation and I have super sensitive skin, rosacea, KP, the works... I haven't had or used this product enough to have a definitive opinion, but what I've gathered so far is this is a great QUICK FIX, not necessary something that will help combat/prevent/deal with long term under eye concerns (bags, dark circles, wrinkles). I honestly am not convinced that eye creams are that effective in general. I think targeting dark circles and bags is better dealt with with under eye masks, cold compresses, tea bags.. and if you are adequately moisturizing your face, it's not that necessary to incorporate an eye cream. Lay it on thick at night, if you have dry normal greasy skin... what i've learned is oily skin is a reaction to your skin crying

avis.titre: It burns, I wash it off usually.
avis.texte: It burns and is so annoying I end up washing it off so I can't really tell if it works. I don't touch my face much but I found it getting in my eyes from itching or simple touching around the eye area. I work in Beauty and bought this for a graduate school project to compare to expensive vs. inexpensive formulas with similar product intent and the e.l.f holy hydration is much cheaper and much more pleasant product with similar intent.. The burning is so annoying. This was the #1 pick on multiple sites for under eye/around the eye challenges.

Fan of Sunday Riley Ice Moisturizer so really wanted to like this product as well. Being using 2x daily for over a month and no improvement to my dark circle or puffiness. I'm moving on and trying a new product as this product is not worth the money.

avis.titre: I will buy this over and over again.
avis.texte: This was suggested to me from the representative of Sunday Riley. I absolutely love it. It opens your eyes when you look tired and helps with the wrinkles around your eyes.

avis.titre: Didn't do anything for undereyes - no effect
avis.texte: I have not noticed much of a difference in my undereyes. I have dark circles and occasional puffiness/sagginess. I never see any change in the appearance of my undereyes. I've been using as part of my morning routine regularly, so I expected to see some sort of effect. I will say it plays well underneath makeup, but so do lots of other eye creams. This costs quite a bit of money for it to not do anything, so I won't be repurchasing nor would I recommend.

I have been using this regularly for a few months as part of my morning routine. I haven't noticed any change in the appearance of my undereye area. Based on that plus the high price, I wont be repurchasing, nor would I recommend this. The product claims have not been proven for me. I struggle with dark circles and this cream doesn't make any difference in their appearance. It does work well under makeup, but thats about it.

I wanted to love it and was hoping the reviews were true. I don't think it's a bad product at all. I like the texture and absorbency and I think it might do a little something. But I have used products that are more effective that cost way less. I just don't think it's worth the price. I will not be purchasing again.
I got this as part of a sample set, and this made the skin around my eyes burn. I tried several times to see if it was just something my skin had to get used to, but nope, it still burns.

I was looking for an eye cream to replace my very expensive one, I did not have high hopes but OMG this eye cream is amazing, within days my slight dark circle disappeared, eye was more lifted, brighter. I loveeeeee this is alsovery hydrating and now I can save money and get better results. Thank you!
Used one time and got a severe rash. I'm a slow learner so I tried Autocorrect again to make sure the rash wasn't caused by anything else and I got the same painful rash.
I love sunday riley products however this is a definite never again. Caused huge swelling and stye. Also flakes and dryness around my eyes. Need a refund asap.

avis.titre: What is the deal with the amount of product in container
avis.texte: This is the 2nd item i've purchase from this brand. I do like the product, but the amount of product in container is ridiculous. I would love to see them change bottles to see exactly how much project is inside. I won't be buying this again. Just got this and almost gone, use once daily small amts
Not only does this cream have caffeine but glycolic acid—which can cause irritation and burning for those with sensitive skin, especially when the directions say to use it twice a day.
Have been using for over a year now, and I love the way it goes on and brightens my eyes.

Ive always loved eye creams especially since i have dry under eyes. But i hadnt found one that really helped wth dark circles just helped wth hydration. Well after trying Auto Correct, i can honestly say this eye cream has helped wth hydration but has actually has made my under eyes brighter. I barely have to use color corrector
I loved the product and it went on so smooth. One of the ingredients bothered my eyes. I would have used it otherwise, but is a bit pricey

avis.titre: Nope, absolutely waste of my money.
avis.texte: I've been using it for a while and have seen absolutely no difference. It's not worth that stiff price!

Instantly delivers a lifted and depuffed look while reducing the appearance of dark circles and fine lines. This is the first time I used it and there's a definite softening of wrinkles. Very nice product. It has a lot of beneficial ingredients like caffeine, lutein, ginseng, horse chestnut, watermelon and more. The area I out it is brighter too l, I just noticed. If it works it works. Not many can do this. I Recommend!
I'm prejudiced because I really am a fan of Sunday Riley products; This eye cream does what it says it does. Definitely for daytime, some may benefit from a specific nighttime eye cream.
It made my under eyes so dry and flakey. After a month of using im gonna have to pass on this
Its gentle, non greasy, and I've noticed it has lightened my under eye area

I got my first sample of auto correct when I bought the good morning set. It worked beautifully and the best part about it is it lasts a long time. So the price is worth it. You don't need two pumps and I'm very happy with the product.
I'm 61 and have genetic dark circles. I've tried so many and this really works. I won't be without it.

Gifted by Sunday Riley. I have sensitive skin especially around my eyes and this did not cause any irritations. This eye cream is hydrating, however, for the price point i did not see any noticeable differences.

Gifted by Sunday Riley. I have really been enjoying this eye cream, it's super hydrating and brightening. It's very lightweight and doesn't feel heavy at all. Sadly though I haven't seen any depuffing yet.

Eye creams are one of the hardest skin care products to be impressed by in my opinion. I tried this new eye cream gifted by Sunday Riley and liked it. It comes in a nice glass bottle with a pump dispenser. The texture is a nice cream that hydrated your under eye area and after using for two weeks I feel like that area is brighter!

I'm obsessed with this eye cream, usually I have a hard time find an eye cream that doesn't cause a reaction around my eye but this one didn't! My under eyes feel to hydrated and plum every time I use it! Gifted by sunday Riley

avis.titre: Makes a tired mommy look refreshed
avis.texte: This is such a winner!! I have very sensitive skin and am a tired mommy of a newborn. My neighbor once saw me outside and said that I looked refreshed and not tired. Well… that's only due to this eyecream!! „Gifted by Sunday Riley"

This product was gifted by Sunday Riley for review purposes only. The packaging is very nice and high quality. I enjoyed how the eye cream made my skin feel nice and moisturized. My eye area looked brighter as well.

Gifted by Sunday Riley. I like that this product is unscented. It contains horse chestnut, which is known for minimizing redness and its soothing effects. This makes it perfect for depuffing around the eyes. The caffeine and ginseng also help with this. This product helps minimize the look of crows feet. It also helps for dark circles. It moisturizes at the same time with watermelon rind extract. Would recommend!

Live it and i love the packaging this is the first time ive tried anything from this brand ive heard alot about im impressed it feels amazing and i apply it everyday so far i do feel a difference definitely recommend. Gifted by Sunday Riley

I recently tried the Sunday Riley Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles, and I am thrilled with the results! This eye cream has truly exceeded my expectations and has become an essential part of my skincare routine. First and foremost, this eye cream effectively targets dark circles and puffiness, which are two common concerns for many of us. After using it consistently for a few weeks, I noticed a visible improvement in the appearance of my dark circles. They appeared brighter and less prominent, giving me a more refreshed and youthful look. What sets this eye cream apart is its brightening properties. The formulation includes ingredients that help to illuminate the under-eye area, making it look more radiant and awake. I appreciate that the brightening effect is subtle and natural, enhancing my overall complexion without any artificial or harsh appearance. The texture of the cream is lightweight and absorbs quickly, which is ideal for an eye product. It doesn't feel heavy or greasy on the skin, allowing me to apply makeup smoothly on top without any issues. Additionally, I noticed that the cream provides a soothing and cooling sensation upon application, which helps to alleviate any puffiness or tiredness around the eyes. Another aspect that I love about Sunday Riley's eye cream is the quality of the ingredients. The brand is known for its commitment to using high-quality, skin-loving ingredients, and this product is no exception. It contains a ble

I was gifted by Sunday Riley and this eye cream has immediately become my new OBSESSION!! The effects of the cream are noticeable instantly, my under eyes are brighter & more firm, and the wear throughout the day is amazing! I absolutely will be using this DAILY!!

I have been using this eye cream for about 1 month to properly review it. I had major puffiness under my eyes, dark circles, and a few fine fines... Using this eye cream consistency for a month, I noticed my puffiness improved so much and my dark circles gone!!!!! I didn't see any difference on my fine lines yet but I have hope it will work as it worked to improve my other imperfections around my eye area. This eye cream is also fragrance free, which I love!! *complimentary from SundayRiley for my honest review after testing it out.

Gifted by Sunday Riley. I love this eye cream. The packaging is so convenient. This feels great under my eyes and helps make them look so much brighter since this has a bit of a yellow sheen. I use this in the mornings.

I used this as an AM eye cream and never noticed any of the claims to depuffing or brightening. In fact, it caused my eyes to twitch like crazy. I'm sure that was the caffeine ingredient but I haven't seen any other reviews mentioning twitching. After I stopped using it, the twitching went away. I use 5 stars at night and have been happy with that product.

Received the auto correct brightening + depicting eye cream complimentary from Sunday Riley in exchange for an honest review. My under eyes have been looking pretty dull and sometimes I'd wake up and they will be puffy. This eye cream completely diminished that.

This is a game changer if you want to ditch your concealer everyday! It seriously helped so much with the overall appearance of my under eyes. They are brighter, more even, and not a single bit of puffiness in sight! I use this in combination with a rose quartz roller to really get that cooling effect. I apply first thing in the morning and then right before I go to bed!

I received this complimentary from Sunday Riley in exchange for my honest review. At 40, my eyes are starting to show my age. It's inevitable and while I've come to accept the march of time, I still love when I can throw it off beat a little. Using this cream 2x daily for a week softened my crows feet and reduces puffiness under my eyes as well. I may not look 20, but I definitely look better rested and more hydrated.

I have been using this eye cream for one week. So far, I have seen improvements. My eyes look less puffy and brighter. I look more youthful. I am looking forward to the long-term results. This was gifted by Sunday Riley.

So exited to have been gifted by Sunday Riley. I started using this product over a week ago and haven't had any issues. When I use this product I do see a difference in my underbags in the am. I look a little bit rested and depuffed.

Gifted by Sunday Riley. I have used many eye creams and serums before but really like the light feel of this one. It doesn't irritate my eyes like other creams do and has helped reduce my eye bags from staring at a screen all day for work! A little goes a long way so this product is worth it.

This feels so nice on my under-eyes! It helps eliminate puffiness and I've even seen an improvement in my dark circles. This is a new favorite every day eye cream for me, and I'm excited to have it part of my daily routine! This was gifted by Sunday Riley in exchange for an honest review.

This was gifted by Sunday Riley. I personally have never used any products by this brand before but this eye cream goes on nicely. It is light but still moisturizing. I have severe dark circles with puffiness. This is helpful to put under concealer. Will see how the darkness and puffiness looks over time.

This stuff is literally my holy grail for under eyes. It helped take away the puffiness and minimized the look of my tired under eyes. I get the worst under eye bags and always look tired and this is the only thing I've found that actually makes a difference and brightens them up! Gifted by Sunday Riley

Sunday Riley gifted me the autocorrect & I'm a long time fan. I love the smooth lightweight texture & how it makes my eyes less puffy looking ...But the beautiful light reflecting brightening pigments it has that gives my under eyes a brighter more awake look is my favorite aspects. It hydrates and smooths as well making it a great morning option.

I highly recommend the Sunday Riley Auto Correct Brightening and Depuffing Eye Contour Cream. It has delivered noticeable improvements in the appearance of dark circles, fine lines, puffiness, and crow's feet. I have struggled with persistent dark circles for years, and this cream has made a significant difference. The formulation seems to brighten the skin around my eyes, making the dark circles less prominent. I often wake up with puffy eyes, especially after a long day or a lack of sleep. However, since incorporating the Auto Correct cream into my routine, the puffiness has decreased significantly. The formula feels soothing and cooling upon application, instantly refreshing the eye area and reducing any swelling. Thank you for the complimentary from Sunday Riley.

Im not a big fan of eye creams but this one changed my mind. It goes so well with the concealer. Hidrates my dry under eyes. has a mild tinted color that makes my eyes look bright. I'm not sure if is from the caffeine but it works so well with my tone of skin. Gifted by Sunday Riley

I love using this eye cream in the morning because it depuffs and brightens my eyes so well. Plus it leaves my under eyes feeling moisturized. I also really appreciate having a pump to dispense the product because it's more hygienic. Gifted by Sunday Riley.

Sunday Riley gifted me their autocorrect eye cream. The formula is very lightweight and absorbs easily. I I have been using it twice a day for a week now. It feels hydrating. I do hope it helps with my dark circles with continued use. I have had amazing results with other products from this line so am hopeful.

I've been using this for the past two weeks and I have really been enjoying it. I have noticed improvement and my under eyes are less puffy and they look brighter. I can't wait to keep using it. Gifted by Sunday Riley.

This eye cream is amazing. It really helps brighten up my dark circles. I like that has caffeine in it because I know that is a natural ingredient that helps brighten up the eyes. You must try it. It's amazing gifted by Sunday Riley

I have been using this eye cream for about two weeks now, and I must say that I'm VERY impressed! I apply this product in both morning and night to cleansed skin and follow up with the rest of my skincare routine. I've noticed that my makeup in the under eye area applies much more smoothly. I do my makeup under a magnified mirror daily, and my under eye skin definitely looks much more supple and hydrated. Because of this, I notice less creasing. Gifted by Sunday riley

Complimentary from sunday riley. They never miss with their products! It feels so luxurious and within a couple days I can instantly see a difference. It melts right into your skin and using it in your PM routine is a dreaam.

Sunday Riley is the best ever!! I use so many of their products and just added this in and it is my new favorite eye cream!! Depuffs and brightens instantly. Definitely recommend using this! Gifted by Sunday Riley

This eye cream is magic!!! It gives me eyes a literal immediate fix- less dark circles, camouflages my lines/wrinkles, and takes the puff down immediately. I use it every morning and evening after I wash my face and it's been a game changer! Gifted by Sunday Riley

Sunday Riley has to be one of my favorite skincare brands. I was so excited to finally try out the auto correct eye cream and it did not disappoint. It uses I gradients like caffeine to help de puff your eye area and concentrated horse chestnut and acmella oleracea extracts to smooth the appearance of your crows feet. This is a winner for me. Gifted by Sunday Riley

New fav eye cream! It's packed with so many great ingredients! The caffeine, ginseng root extract, horse chestnut extract, acmella oleracea extract, watermelon rind extract, and lutein all work together to reduce the appearance of dark circles, puffiness, and crows feet. These also help to build the moisture barrier and strengthen the delicate skin around the eye. These are my immediate results from using this product- I took the after photo about 15 mins after applying the product. I can see that my eyes look less dark and puffy- it also deeply hydrated this area to reduce the appearance of wrinkles/crows feet. I was shocked by this visible difference! Complimentary from Sunday Riley.

Wooooohooo!! Finally something that hides my tired eyes after very very little sleep these days- toooo much work. I feel that this brightens my eyes. Gifted by Sunday Riley, but the review is my own!!!

I love this eye cream! It brightens my undereyes really well. I've been using it for a few weeks and I really think it improves my dark circles. It's also very moisturizing. I have very sensitive skin under my eyes and this doesn't irritate them at all. Gifted by Sunday Riley.
